:::{#hero-heading} 

I am an Economist at the [Office of the Chief Economist](https://copyright.gov/economic-research) at the U.S. Copyright Office, where I study copyright's economic impacts and make data on copyright registrations more accessible to researchers.

Before this, I spent about a decade teaching economics, most recently as Associate Professor of Economics at [Hood College](https://www.hood.edu/academics/departments/george-b-delaplaine-jr-school-business). My [course materials](teaching.qmd) and other [software tools](software.qmd) are freely available and I now write for a general audience on [Substack](https://ryansafner.substack.com).

I consider myself a lifelong learner and tinkerer. My own research projects explore the political economy of innovation and economic growth, from 17^th^ century English institutions to generative AI using frameworks like [new institutional economics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_institutional_economics), [public choice](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_choice), [market process economics](http://www.econlib.org/library/Enc/AustrianSchoolofEconomics.html), and [computational models](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agent-based_model).

## Featured Research!

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
library(htmltools)
papers <- yaml::read_yaml("papers.yaml")
feat <- Filter(function(p) isTRUE(p$featured), papers)

# first ~n characters of the abstract, cut at a word boundary, markdown stripped
snippet <- function(x, n = 220) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
  x <- gsub("[*_]", "", trimws(x))
  if (nchar(x) <= n) return(x)
  paste0(sub("\\s+\\S*$", "", substr(x, 1, n)), "…")
}

card <- function(p) {
  venue <- if (!is.null(p$journal)) p$journal else if (p$type == "wip") "Working paper" else ""
  if (!is.null(p$year)) venue <- paste(c(venue, p$year), collapse = " · ")
  link  <- if (!is.null(p$published_url)) p$published_url else "research.html"
  div(class = "col",
    a(class = "card h-100 feature-card", href = link,
      div(class = "card-body",
        div(class = "card-subtitle", venue),
        h5(class = "card-title", p$title),
        if (!is.null(p$abstract)) p(class = "card-text", snippet(p$abstract))
      )))
}

cards <- div(class = "row row-cols-1 row-cols-md-3 g-3", lapply(feat, card))
cat("```{=html}\n", as.character(cards), "\n```\n", sep = "")
```

```{r}
              get(i, "title"), get(i, "link"), d, get(i, "description")))
}
```
